d.ko: Jude Gray, a wandering Courier, receives a request to deliver some very special cargo. This cargo turns out to be Philia, an android girl who is unaffected by the enigmatic Singularity Machines.
d.en: Jude Gray, a wandering Courier, receives a request to deliver some very special cargo. This cargo turns out to be Philia, an android girl who is unaffected by the enigmatic Singularity Machines.
d.zh: 货运人“裘德”有一天收到了一个委托。要求他去运送一位不受奇点机器群影响的少女型仿生人——“菲利亚”。尽管对菲利亚不谙世事的行为感到厌烦，裘德还是踏上了旅程。时而逃离掠夺的人类，时而穿越机器群横行的危险地带，尽全力去完成运送的委托。
